summary: CHA-0001 remedy, criteria 15/16: pre-remedy failure evidence for RejectsAbsorbingDeltaTimeThatWouldNeverAdvanceTheSchedule (fails in 76ms with BoundedBufferCapacityExceededException at the 1000-item cap, not a hang, against WaveScheduler.Tick before the non-progress check existed) and AcceptsALargeDeltaTimeThatCanStillAdvanceTheSchedule (already green pre-remedy, since it guards against over-rejection rather than the hang).
